BAh7CEkiCGdpZAY6BkVUSSI6Z2lkOi8vanVtcHN0.description:
What if your team completed every quarterly priority, but the business still got weaker?

In this video, Hayden Miyamoto explains why completed work is not always real progress, and how to use OKRs to connect company priorities back to the financial result that actually matters.

You’ll see how to work backward from the P&L, turn a company objective into measurable Key Results, separate projects from tasks, and use AI to keep progress visible before problems show up too late.

Use this if your team is busy, your priorities look organized, but profit is still moving in the wrong direction.
